title: Skin Electrical Resistance as a Diagnostic and Therapeutic Biomarker of Breast Cancer Measuring Lymphatic Regions
summary: The study reports AUC 0.68 and includes longitudinal treatment measurements from six patients. Diagnostic performance is modest and the investigational cohort is small; treatment-response evidence from six patients is preliminary.
ai_technology: A random-forest classifier uses skin electrical-resistance measurements to distinguish malignant from benign breast lesions.
